objective: 实现revision-bound semantic correction fact、只读Runtime-to-UniAgent obligation输入与derived checkpoint proposal，不修改Agent行为或任何执行权威

semantic_brief.summary: Buyer：Slow已能输出当前revision的challenge/correct证据，但Runtime尚无安全的上层消费边界。新增不可变修正事实与只读obligation reevaluation输入，表达C仍pending、D被observed及wrong-branch含义；不写ledger、不发action。

change_principles: NEW_SYMBOL_JUSTIFICATION必须说明为何不能扩展Agent-owned BranchProgressEvidence、GoalEvidence、ActiveContainerContext或Slow assessment本身
correction fact必须绑定Slow consumption中的ObservationRef、revision、NodeRef、SourceNodeRef、TriggerOccurrenceRef和TransitionOccurrenceRef；缺少wrong-child必需ref时fail closed
只有Available、IsCurrent且assessment为Challenge或Correct的consumption可产生current correction；stale/rejected/disabled/unavailable/insufficient/confirm均不得产生修正输入
obligation input只表达intended semantic仍需owner重算、observed corrected semantic与task context；不得声称已把D写入visited或把C写回pending
traversal mis-click与directed-entry wrong-branch必须是不同derived implication；两者都不得调用action/recovery/completion
checkpoint仅由调用者提供的当前execution-path confirmation evidence纯推导；没有sufficiently confirmed correct-path node则不产生proposal
不得创建interface，除非搜索证明有两个实现或替换/测试seam buyer；优先immutable records和static pure projector
你不是仓库唯一执行者；不得回退或覆盖他人/用户修改，发现scope文件并发变化则停止上报Leader
acceptance: WorkResult给出existing symbol搜索与CREATE裁决；不得新增无真实buyer的interface/service/store
production contract提供exact evidence-bound correction fact、只读UniAgent obligation reevaluation input、task context/derived implication及optional derived checkpoint proposal
traversal测试证明Fast intended C而Slow corrected D时输出C remains pending candidate与D observed fact，但HasAppliedObligationMutation/HasAction/HasRecovery/HasCompletion恒为false
directed-entry测试证明wrong branch只输出requires-owner-reevaluation/authorization proposal，不发return/recover/reenter action
stale/rejected/disabled/unavailable/confirm/insufficient及缺失必需binding均fail closed且不产生current correction
checkpoint测试证明仅从当前execution-path中sufficiently confirmed correct node产生proposal；无合格node、off-path node或stale revision不fabricate checkpoint
targeted correction+Slow+Fast+V2 core+legacy transition tests、Runtime Rebuild、git diff --check通过
forbidden: 禁止修改OpenSpec、docs、WorkItem、tasks checkbox或scope.write之外任何文件
禁止把correction写入ContainerRuntimeV2State、Graph、CurrentContainer、WorldBelief、ledger或任何latest mutable slot
禁止创建Correction/Checkpoint/Recovery FSM、Graph checkpoint subtype、canonical parent、scheduler、queue、cache或provider/backend
禁止把Slow confidence/correction/checkpoint proposal当world truth、action authorization或GoalEvidence
禁止放宽exact binding与stale fail-closed或删除测试取得GREEN
escalation: 若必须修改Agent/Goal/BranchProgress/ActiveContainerContext才可表达消费，返回REQUIRED_HUMAN_GATE_UPPER_AUTHORITY，不扩scope
若checkpoint必须引入mutable lifecycle/Graph subtype/recovery plan，返回DEFER_CHECKPOINT_IMPLEMENTATION
若Slow现有contract缺少exact binding导致必须修改Slow文件，先返回CONTRACT_GAP，不越scope
若scope文件存在不明并发修改或失败指向scope外，保留现场并返回Expected/Observed/Gap/FirstDivergence/Owner
